question: Will HYPE be above $65 at 7:59 PM EDT on August 31, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the HYPE-USD spot price is strictly above $65.00 at the observation time of 23:59 UTC on August 31, 2026 (7:59 PM EDT), as reported by Coinbase.
- "No": Wins if the HYPE-USD spot price is at or below $65.00 at the observation time of 23:59 UTC on August 31, 2026 (7:59 PM EDT), as reported by Coinbase.
